title: Large Language Models Enhanced Personalized Graph Neural Architecture Search in Federated Learning

layout.note: Top band: four prompt cards in a 2x2 grid (cards 1-2 left, 3-4 right). A dashed divider follows. Middle band, left to right: LLM controller and architecture list, the server in the centre, a dashed orange region with supernet and stacked clients at the right. Bottom band: a framed legend strip.

lesson: Show an LLM's prompt as a band of numbered, titled grey cards with coloured slots above the system, and let the feedback arrow climb back into the last card so the loop closes without extra boxes. A legend strip of coloured sample arrows names each message type.
